✓ Place within 3 feet of the curb no earlier than 6 p.m. the
night before and no later than 6 a.m. on collection day.
✓ Keep at least 3 feet away from other carts, mailboxes,
parked cars, and low-hanging tree limbs.
✓ Ensure lids fully close.
✓ Face handles toward the house and lid arrows
toward the street.
✓ After collection, put empty carts away on the same day.
✓ Rinse or clean the carts as needed.
✓ Visit ocfl.net/DamagedCart to request cart repair
or replacement.
X DON’T stack items on top of or alongside carts.
X DON’T place household hazardous waste, such as paint,
pool chemicals, rechargeable batteries, automobile parts/
fluids, propane tanks, and freon-containing devices, in
the carts. They are not included in the curbside collection
program and some of these items are flammable, which
could lead to truck fires. Visit ocfl.net/HHW for
disposal information.
X DON’T overfill carts.
X DON’T block meters or utility boxes.
